title: WaveDrom
description:
WaveJSON: WaveDrom timing diagram, bit-field (register), or logic circuit description
https://wavedrom.com

assign.description: List of assignments, one cone per item: ["out", expression], e.g. ["z", ["&", "a", ["~", "b"]]]

fontWidth.description: Average character width (px) used for label box sizing

assignTree.title: logic expression

items.description: First item: operator (gate type) or output / leaf name; second item: optional attributes object; then operands

anyOf.description: Node attributes (only as the second element)

width.description: Bus width (0 - zero-width, 1 - scalar wire, >1 - vector bus)

dir.description: Port direction, draws chevron-shaped port box

imm.description: Folded immediate literal appended to the operator label, e.g. "8'h55"

reg.description: List of bit fields, starting from LSB (bit 0). Sum of "bits" defines the register width unless config.bits is set.

name.description: Field name. String / JsonML is rendered centered; a number is rendered as binary value across the field bits (e.g. opcode 0x37). Field without name and type is drawn as reserved (shaded).

attr.description: Field attribute(s), rendered below the field, one row per array item. Number is rendered as binary. null items are skipped.

type.description: Field color type: 2 red, 3 lime, 4 cyan, 5 amber, 6 green, 7 blue; other values - gray shade. Used as key for config.legend.

rotate.description: Rotation angle of the field name (degrees), e.g. -90 for narrow fields

rect.description: Extra SVG attributes for the field background <rect>, e.g. {"style": "fill:#ff0;fill-opacity:0.3"}

vspace.description: Lane height (px). Default: (max number of attr rows + 4) * fontsize

lanes.description: Number of lanes (rows) the register is split into

bits.description: Overall bit width (default: sum of field bits)

compact.description: Compact format: lanes stacked without gaps, bit numbers shown once on top

hflip.description: Horizontal flip: LSB lane on top

vflip.description: Vertical flip: bit 0 on the left

sparse.description: Sparse cage: draw tick marks only at field boundaries

uneven.description: Uneven lanes: with odd bit width the last lane is one bit shorter (used with sparse)

trim.description: Trim long field names to fit the field ("..."); value is the estimated character width (px), e.g. 8

offset.description: Offset added to the bit index labels

legend.description: Color legend above the diagram: {"label": type}, e.g. {"Control": 2, "Status": 4}

margin.description: Margins around the diagram (px). Defaults depend on fontsize, attr rows and labels.

label.description: Lane labels on the left / right side (margins grow to 10% of hspace)

left.description: Lane labels on the left side: string - same label on every lane; number N - lane index + N; array - label per lane (index 0 = LSB lane)

items.description: Text (string / JsonML). A number is rendered as its binary value, one bit per bit cell.

right.description: Lane labels on the right side: string - same label on every lane; number N - lane index + N; array - label per lane (index 0 = LSB lane)

items.description: Text (string / JsonML). A number is rendered as its binary value, one bit per bit cell.

textSpan.description: Text: plain string with optional inline markup <b> <i> <o> (overline) <ins> (underline) <s> (strike) <sub> <sup> <tt> (monospace), e.g. "CS<sub>n</sub>", "<o>RST</o>"; or a number; or JsonML (SVG tspan) markup, e.g. ["tspan", {"class": "h1"}, "Title"]

jsonml.title: JsonML
jsonml.description: JsonML (SVG) markup: ["tag", {attributes}, ...children], e.g. ["tspan", {"class": "h1"}, "Title"]. Usual tag is "tspan"; children are strings, numbers or nested JsonML nodes.

items.description: First item: SVG tag name (usually "tspan"); then optional attributes object; then children

anyOf.description: SVG attributes, e.g. {"class": "h3"}, {"fill": "red"}, {"font-weight": "bold"}, {"dy": "-5"}. Theme classes: h1..h6, muted, info, success, warning, error

textNode.description: Header / footer of the timing diagram

text.description: Title text (plain string, inline <b>/<i>/<sub>... markup, or JsonML tspan markup), rendered centered

tick.description: Tick labels aligned to the cycle boundaries (clock edges). Number N: sequential cycle labels N, N+1, N+2, ... (shifted by config.hbounds[0]). String: space-separated explicit labels, e.g. "A B C" (note: WaveDrom 3.x appends the hbounds offset to the string, so the last label becomes "C0"; prefer a number).

tock.description: Tock labels placed in the middle of each cycle. Number N: sequential cycle labels N, N+1, N+2, ... (shifted by config.hbounds[0]). String: space-separated explicit labels, e.g. "A B C" (note: WaveDrom 3.x appends the hbounds offset to the string, so the last label becomes "C0"; prefer a number).

every.description: Show only every N-th tick / tock label (labels whose value is divisible by N). Works only with numeric tick / tock.

waveLane.title: wave lane
waveLane.description: Signal descriptor. Empty object {} creates a gap between lanes. Lane without "name" (e.g. only "node") is not drawn but still occupies a row and may carry edge nodes.

name.description: Signal label, rendered left of the wave. Plain string (inline <b>/<i>/<sub>/<o>... markup supported) or JsonML tspan markup.

wave.description: Signal activity, one character per cycle (or piece-wise analog ["pw", {d}] array)

oneOf.title: piece-wise wave
oneOf.description: Piece-wise analog wave: ["pw", {"d": SVG path}]. Path uses relative SVG commands (m l h v q t a) where x unit = 1 cycle, y unit = lane height (positive y goes up).

d.description: SVG path data, e.g. "m0,0 l1,1 h2 l1,-1" or ["m", 0, 0, "l", 1, 1]

data.description: Labels for data (value) cycles "=" and "2"-"9", in order of appearance: array of text items, or a single space-separated string "A B C". Items hidden by negative phase / hbounds are skipped.

period.description: Lane period: width of one wave character in cycles (default 1). E.g. 2 for half-rate clock, 0.5 for double rate.

phase.description: Phase shift in cycles (default 0). Positive value shifts the wave to the left (into the past, earlier); negative to the right (delay). Wave is shifted in half-cycle steps; nodes and over / under lines use exact value.

node.description: Named nodes (anchors for "edge" arrows), one character per cycle (at cycle start, scaled by period / phase): "." - no node; uppercase letters - invisible node; other characters (lowercase, digits ...) - node with visible label. Each character should be unique across the diagram.

over.description: Colored line above the lane (with serif marks), one character per period: "1"-"8" start a line of that color (1 black, 2 red, 3 green, 4 blue, 5 magenta, 6 olive, 7 teal, 8 violet); "0" ends the line; "." extends previous state

under.description: Colored line below the lane, one character per period: "1"-"8" start a line of that color; "0" ends the line; "." extends previous state

waveGroup.title: wave group
waveGroup.description: Group of wave lanes drawn with a bracket on the left. Optional first element (string or number) is the group label. Groups can be nested.

oneOf.description: Group label (only the first element is used as label, other strings are ignored)
Group label (only the first element is used as label, other numbers are ignored)

signal.description: List of wave lanes {name, wave, data, ...} and wave groups ["label", lane, ...]

head.description: Diagram header: title text and / or tick / tock cycle labels

foot.description: Diagram footer: caption text and / or tick / tock cycle labels

edge.description: Arrows between nodes defined in lane "node" strings

hscale.description: Horizontal scale: width multiplier of a cycle (rounded to integer, 1..100)

skin.description: Skin name. Must be loaded on the page (skins/*.js); unknown skin falls back to "default". Skin applies to the whole page (first diagram).

hbounds.description: Visible horizontal window [start, end] in cycles (start rounded down, end rounded up; ignored unless start < end). Shifts tick / tock labels and hides data labels before start.

arcFontSize.description: Font size (px) of edge (arc) labels and node labels

signal.description: Timing diagram: list of wave lanes and groups

else.description: Root object must have "signal", "assign" or "reg" property
